title: Dreaming Under Cosmic Moon
description: A woman with dark hair sleeps peacefully in bed, covered by a vibrant patchwork quilt featuring space and fantasy motifs. Above her, a large crescent moon window reveals a starry cosmos with planets, while speech bubbles with doodles float in the dreamy night sky; scattered tarot-like cards and chocolates lie nearby.
prompt: A serene woman with flowing dark hair sleeps on her side in a cozy bed, covered by a beautifully detailed patchwork quilt with celestial, fantasy and storybook patterns in rich purples, golds and blues. A large glowing crescent moon window above her reveals a colorful cosmic scene with planets and stars inside. Whimsical speech bubbles with doodles and smiley faces float in the dark blue dreamy sky. Scattered tarot cards, one showing a figure, and chocolates rest on the bed and nightstand. Soft atmospheric lighting, magical and peaceful mood, detailed digital painting.
